behavioral_value.interpretation: Reproducible descriptive advantage with materially higher compute cost; descriptive value alone is insufficient for promotion.

causal_gate.reason: B06 did not establish learned recurrent-delta necessity, sufficiency, or a disproportionately necessary causal core. B07 transfer and distribution probes remained small and seed-dependent.

brittleness_gate.reason: B07 fixed-seed reruns and sign checks passed 6/6; p95/p99 clipping caused only small effects and ±2% recurrent perturbation caused microscopic action-vector divergence.

1_representational_crowding.evidence: Within- and across-context postdevelopment cosine similarities remain above approximately 0.99994, with context-separation only 2.70e-6 to 3.00e-6 despite higher effective dimensionality and modest behavioral differentiation.

2_cross_context_interference.evidence: Block-anchor retention is mixed and closely parallels the legacy control; no reproducible majority-seed challenger-specific erasure pattern is established.

3_persistent_saturation_or_gain_bound_pr.evidence: State gain reaches the configured upper bound 1.20 by the end of phase 1 and remains exactly 1.20 through every development block and final evaluation on all six seeds, while measured saturation remains 0.0.

4_capacity_like_causal_concentration.evidence: The top 5% of recurrent deltas contain disproportionate delta magnitude but are not disproportionately necessary behaviorally under B06/B07 lesions.

5_no_observed_plateau_evidence.evidence: No preregistered scaling study was executed, so the 4,096-unit result cannot establish a scaling plateau.

capacity_trigger.interpretation: At least two preregistered capacity-warning indicators are reproducibly present across at least four of six seeds. Architectural rejection at 4,096 units is therefore prohibited by B02 section 10.2 if the challenger would otherwise be rejected as default.

disposition: RETAIN OPTIONAL - CAPACITY ADEQUACY UNRESOLVED; SCALING STUDY REQUIRED BEFORE REJECTION
required_follow_up: Write a new versioned scaling preregistration before any larger-network decisive run. Preserve the reserved 1,024 -> 4,096 -> 16,384 -> 65,536 ladder or document hardware/runtime infeasibility for an omitted rung.
